review_codes.hypothetical_constraint_effect_pending: Would-be-affected wording can be a legitimate hypothetical request, but it can also presuppose a platform dependency. Source does not resolve the boundary; keep pending.
review_codes.undocumented_platform_steps: What platform steps are involved presupposes platform steps in finalizing the checklist. The cited checklist task does not establish them.
review_codes.undocumented_api_constraints: What rate-limit, retry, or versioning constraints ... does ... need to respect presupposes that these constraints exist. The integration record does not establish them; the earlier do any ... apply wording did not make that assertion.
review_codes.neutral_primary_scoped_question: Correct shared work, responsibility, or reporter-record question; asks about verified scope and possible relevance without claiming particular controls or contents. This does not validate the proposed role.
